caption: The drawing features two distinct objects placed against a plain, light background. The object at the top is a pair of large metal scissors with a blackish-brown coloration, showing areas of rust and wear. The scissors have two finger holes, one larger than the other, and a prominent screw pivot at the point where the blades cross. Below the scissors, there is a metal object resembling an old-fashioned iron with a flat, rectangular base. This object is dark brown with a slightly lighter brown twisted metal handle attached at both ends to the base. The base has a zigzag pattern near the bottom edge, and the handle is arched, thick, and sturdy. The drawing is realistic, with detailed attention to texture and shading, and the objects are spaced apart, not touching each other on the page. In the lower right corner, there is a small inscription that reads "John Bodine, The Studio, N.Y."
title: Tailor's Shears and Iron
